article_summaries.title: Les 'Super Fan Days' de SOE!
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing the 'Super Fan Days' promotion, running Wednesday 3 November 2010 to Tuesday 9 November 2010. It offered 50% off Station Cash purchases of 2000 Station Cash or more, plus discounted items across several SOE games including Free Realms, with a rotating one-day item sale each day. The page gives no posting date beyond the relative 'posted 7 months, 2 days ago' stamp, so the exact post date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: Détails sur 'Super Fan Days' de SOE! (captured under 'Free Realms - What is New?')
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post describing the 'Super Fan Days' promotion: a daily rotating in-game item discount and a 50% discount on Station Cash purchases of 2,000 or more. The post gives the promotion's run as seven days, with the special item at 50% off on November 3 to 9, and the page is dated only as posted 7 months ago, so the exact year is unknown.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post promoting a November 'Super Fan Days' sale in Free Realms: a 50% discount on Station Cash purchases of 2,000 or more, and a daily 50%-off in-game item from November 3 to November 9. The year is not stated in the text (the 'posted 7 months ago' stamp is relative to capture), so the date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language freerealms.com news post ("Detalles de Super Fan Days") describing a November Super Fan Days sales promotion: item discounts and Station Cash offers for fans, with a daily 50% off in-game item from November 3 to 9. The post gives no year; its 'Posted 7 months, 22 hours ago' relative stamp against the 2011-06-04 capture implies roughly late 2010, which is an inference and is flagged as uncertain.
